penny_truth.label: Penny / Copper Thread — Colonel's Cut
penny_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The smallest unit is the one the system ignores — that is where control lives.

supercap_truth.label: Supercapacitor / Energy — Colonel's Cut
supercap_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Energy is stored time. They who control the charge control the clock.

versa_truth.label: Versa / Commute — Colonel's Cut
versa_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Three hours a day spent between places — that is the rent the terrain collects.

mother_truth.label: Mother / Penny Motif — Colonel's Cut
mother_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: She ran into the streets for pennies. The system was built to make her run.

foster_truth.label: Foster / Devices Taken — Colonel's Cut
foster_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: They took the devices so you'd read the world instead. That was the lesson.

paulsen_truth.label: Paulsen / Wilderness — Colonel's Cut
paulsen_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The terrain does not negotiate. Nature collects what the machine promises you beat.

metalgear_truth.label: Metal Gear / Colonel — Colonel's Cut
metalgear_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: You are not fighting a villain. You are fighting the system that made the villain necessary.

colonel_truth.label: Colonel of Truth — Colonel's Cut
colonel_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The Colonel was lying. So is the feed. The difference is the feed never admits it.

cuda_truth.label: CUDA / Compute — Colonel's Cut
cuda_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Compute is the new combustion. Whoever owns the chips sets the weather.

llm_truth.label: LLM / AI — Colonel's Cut
llm_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The model is a very fast opinion-haver. In 2020 the opinions got loud.

diabetes_truth.label: Diabetes / Health — Colonel's Cut
diabetes_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: A body is the first system they told you was yours but billed you for.

ev_truth.label: EV / Hybrid Architecture — Colonel's Cut
ev_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The hybrid is a compromise the system forced. The supercapacitor is the dream it delayed.

pokemon_truth.label: Pokémon / Gaming Lore — Colonel's Cut
pokemon_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Every creature is a captured fact. The dex is just a timeline you can't close.

jeff_truth.label: Jeff (recurring bit) — Colonel's Cut
jeff_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: A name repeated enough becomes a variable. Who is Jeff to the system?

daniel_truth.label: Daniel (recurring bit) — Colonel's Cut
daniel_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: The second name is the control group. Compare Jeff to Daniel and watch the pattern.

gun_truth.label: Gun / Conflict — Colonel's Cut
gun_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: A weapon is a fact that ends the argument. The feed is a weapon that starts them.

chaos_truth.label: Chaos / Systems — Colonel's Cut
chaos_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Chaos is the system speaking without the press release.

heat_truth.label: Heat / Climate — Colonel's Cut
heat_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: Heat is the bill for every combustion we refused to price.

capture_truth.label: Capture / Absorb — Colonel's Cut
capture_truth.colonel_frame: The Colonel's version: To capture is to refuse the feed's amnesia. The absorber remembers so you don't have to.
